# ================================================================
#  Burden of Infrastructure — housing event values (2026-11-08)
#  Events: events/boi_housing_events.txt (generated by
#  tools/Build-HousingEvents.py). All numbers are test values.
# ================================================================

# ── State scope ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

boi_hev_state_camp_levels = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_building = {
		limit = { has_active_production_method = pm_boi_work_camp }
		add = level
	}
}

# Work Towns and Serviced Towns.
boi_hev_state_town_levels = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_building = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_active_production_method = pm_boi_work_town
				has_active_production_method = pm_boi_serviced_town
			}
		}
		add = level
	}
}

# Work Camps on mines and logging camps.
boi_hev_state_extraction_camp_levels = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_building = {
		limit = {
			has_active_production_method = pm_boi_work_camp
			OR = {
				is_building_group = bg_mining
				is_building_group = bg_logging
			}
		}
		add = level
	}
}

# Company housing (camp or town) on farms and ranches.
boi_hev_state_farm_company_levels = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_building = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_active_production_method = pm_boi_work_camp
				has_active_production_method = pm_boi_work_town
			}
			OR = {
				is_building_group = bg_agriculture
				is_building_group = bg_ranching
			}
		}
		add = level
	}
}

boi_hev_state_industry_levels = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_building = {
		limit = { is_building_group = bg_manufacturing }
		add = level
	}
}

# Building scope: smaller first (Great Fire burns the smallest urban industry).
boi_hev_building_smallness = {
	value = 0
	subtract = level
}

# ── Country scope ───────────────────────────────────────────────

boi_hev_camp_levels = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_state = { add = boi_hev_state_camp_levels }
}

boi_hev_low_tier_levels = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_state = { add = boi_cm_state_low_tier_levels }
}

boi_hev_municipal_levels = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_state = {
		every_scope_building = {
			limit = { is_building_type = building_boi_municipal_estates }
			add = level
		}
	}
}

boi_hev_cheap_luxury_states = {
	value = 0
	every_scope_state = {
		limit = { sg:boi_luxury_housing = { state_goods_cheaper >= 0.25 } }
		add = 1
	}
}

# Money the event gives (positive) or costs (negative).
boi_hev_grant = {
	value = gdp
	multiply = 0.003
	min = 3000
}

boi_hev_payment = {
	value = gdp
	multiply = -0.003
	max = -3000
}

boi_hev_payment_large = {
	value = gdp
	multiply = -0.008
	max = -8000
}

# State scope. A philanthropist's pledge: half a good level per Slum or
# Workers' Rows level in the state, at least 1.
boi_pledge_target_state = {
	value = boi_cm_state_low_tier_levels
	divide = 2
	ceiling = yes
	min = 1
}
